Manufacturers sometimes ask that retailers not display a price if it drops below a certain amount. The “Show Price” message indicates that the price of the item is so low that the manufacturer requested that it not be advertised (that is, displayed). In a brick-and-mortar store, you would probably have to ask a salesperson what the price of the product is.\n \n At Amazon, by selecting “Show Price” you are essentially asking to see the price, at which point we show it to you.

 HTML page authors need specify their expected weinre server host and port. They should include http://[weinre host]:[port]/target/target-script-min.js to their page. They can complete this ethier by themselves or by calling the MASH server side api.
 Note:
 1. We will only include the weinre debug info into app context when weinre debug status is on.
 2. If the HTML developer doesn't set the weinre host and port, we will include the default weinre debug info into the app context. The default server host is localhost on which the android emulator is running, and the default port is 8080.
